metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and skills for the Go-native ecosystem — idiomatic Go development (golang-pro), Temporal durable workflows, OpenFGA fine-grained authorization, k6 load and performance testing, and SigNoz observability.

plugins.name: temporal-developer
plugins.description: Develop, debug, and manage Temporal workflows across Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java. Covers durable execution, non-determinism, signals, queries, versioning, and AI/LLM patterns.

plugins.name: golang-pro
plugins.description: Go language development skills, agents, and commands. Covers idiomatic patterns, TDD, concurrency, gRPC, browser automation (Playwright, go-rod), and DBOS durable workflows.

plugins.name: openfga
plugins.description: Design, review, and refactor OpenFGA authorization models — types, relations, tuples, can_* permissions, usersets, and .fga.yaml tests across JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, and .NET.

plugins.name: k6
plugins.description: Write, debug, and run k6 load and performance tests in JavaScript/TypeScript — scripts, test types, thresholds, scenarios, executors, browser tests, result analysis, k6 Cloud, CI/CD, and an end-to-end website performance-testing workflow.

plugins.name: signoz
plugins.description: SigNoz observability — MCP setup, docs search, metrics/log/trace queries, dashboards, alerts, and ClickHouse queries via the SigNoz MCP server.
